extras: Mobile use is limited to opening a developer console; theming requires editing xterm.js options in profile data. The README also documents system access and security reporting.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open a shell or terminal alongside notes.

relations.evidence: Refer to the xterm.js documentation (ITerminalOptions) to set the options.
ConPTY terminals run on the console host that Windows Terminal ships

summary: Plugin that runs external terminal emulators and integrated shells inside Obsidian, with profiles, history, and tab status.
